title: Qt: Update main display filter entry when filter changed programmatically
description:
WiresharkMainWindow::filterPackets is a slot called by the main display
filter entry as well as other dialogs (and the command line option) to
filter packets. When something else calls it, the main display filter
entry still needs to update its text and history.

Restore some of the behavior pre !25176 by at least ensuring that the
text in the main display filter edit reflects the newly applied filter.

The history is still not applied and this is not the ideal long-term
solution, but it fixes the worst of #21301.

AI-Assisted: no
